analysis.title: Bold Dark Hot-Sauce Landing Page
analysis.notes: A near-black canvas pairs oversized cream typography with a centered product composition, warm gold geometry, and floating pineapple pieces. The editorial grid is deliberately interrupted by the bottle and ingredients, creating a tactile, irreverent food-brand presentation.
analysis.heroPrompt: Create a high-end product hero image on a nearly black background: a dark glass sauce bottle with a glossy black cap, centered slightly low in frame, surrounded by chunky golden pineapple pieces and a muted ochre circular shape behind it. Use dramatic studio lighting, strong specular reflections, deep shadows, tactile food texture, and a handcrafted premium packaging mood. Compose it for a bold editorial landing page with generous negative space above, no readable text, no logos, and no brand identifiers.
